🐦 🔯 ↣ by @0xRicker (11K)
MAC v0.2 - what shipped since launch

Comms upgrade, so here is everything that changed under the hood, in one place.

Routing

The gate used to score a task once and commit. Now it re-scores after classify, so a task that looked cheap but arrives with 400k of context does not get stuffed into an 8k window and silently truncated.

Tier ladder is explicit: nano → small → frontier. A task only climbs if the cheaper tier fails the eval, never because the prompt "feels hard".

Dedupe

Window went from exact-match to hash(intent + normalised args), 30m rolling.

That caught the thing I did not expect: the same question arriving from two different agents in the same minute, worded differently. Those used to be two frontier calls.

Batching

90s hold window, fan-in on identical intent.

Added a bail-out: if anything in the batch is marked irreversible, the whole batch breaks apart and each item routes on its own. Batching ...read more
